units.source_text: 我作此想，实属懦怯堪怜。

en.t: For me to think this way is truly pitiably cowardly.

units.source_text: 对君之毅然决然，惭愧之至，羡慕之极！”

en.t: Before your firm resolve, I feel the deepest shame and the greatest admiration!"

units.source_text: 此时众侍女围集藤壶皇后身旁，源氏大将心中千言万语，不能发泄，但觉异常烦闷。

en.t: At that moment, many ladies-in-waiting had gathered around Empress Fujitsubo, and General Genji, with countless words in his heart yet unable to give them voice, felt extraordinarily distressed.
